releases.name: Sprinting Tweaks Prerelease 2
releases.body:
**This is a prerelease.**
### Changes
- There is now a config option for whether or not vertical thrust is allowed while sprinting.
- The player will now start sprinting if they are moving over the ground with the sprint button held. The player will stop sprinting if they stop moving over the ground, stop holding the sprint button (unless "Hold to Sprint" is disabled), or start boosting (unless "Allow Vertical Thrust while Sprinting" is enabled).

releases.name: Prerelease for Sprinting Tweaks
releases.body:
**This is a prerelease.**

You can now bind the sprint button to any button on your keyboard/gamepad. You can also now toggle whether or not the sprint button must be held to maintain a sprint.

The player will now start sprinting when they are standing on valid ground, are holding a directional input, have just pressed the sprint button, and were not already holding a vertical thrust button. The player will maintain sprinting while they are holding a directional input, have not just pressed a vertical thrust button, and are either on valid ground or not starting a boost. If "Hold to Sprint" is enabled in the config menu, the sprint button must also be held to maintain a sprint.

**Please give this a try if you can! I'm looking for feedback on these changes.**

releases.name: v1.6.8
releases.body:
### Changes
- There is now a half-second cooldown after Wall Jumping in which you cannot Emergency Boost, which fixes an issue where you could Emergency Boost while trying to Wall Jump.
- You can no longer Wall-Jump while thrusting upwards, which fixes an issue where you would wall jump while trying to boost.
- Removed the ability to disable Wall Jumping while suited because of the above bugfix.
- The player's jump height will now scale properly with Smol Hatchling v2.0.0.

releases.name: v1.6.7
releases.body: Quick patch for compatibility with Smol Hatchling v1.5.1.

releases.name: v1.6.6: Sprinting Tweaks
releases.body:
- Reverted some very strange features that snuck into the last release.
- Sprinting is now enabled by default *everywhere.*
  - Pursuers will now pursue faster when you're sprinting.
- Made sprinting slightly slower to prevent stinky cheese.
- Emergency Boost and Floaty Physics are now experimental features that are disabled by default.
- Emergency Boosting now costs 30% of your fuel by default.
- Added an option to change the jetpack's maximum fuel capacity.

releases.name: v1.6.4: Bugfixes
releases.body:
- MonoBehaviors now properly unsubscribe from events, preventing config errors after the first loop.
- Fixed a bug that made the climbing animation not play.

releases.name: v1.6.3: Bugfixing and Tweaks
releases.body:
- Jetpack thruster flame no longer appears while sprinting if the jetpack is off or invisible.
- You can now configure how quickly you have to double-tap the jump button to do an emergency boost.
- Fixed a bug where setting the Jump Power in config wouldn't do anything
- Added an option to set your minimum jump power (how high you will jump if you don't charge your jump)
- Removed API (temporarily? lemme know if anyone actually needs it)
- You can now set the minimum acceleration you will move when using Floaty Physics and the gravity at which you will reach this acceleration.

releases.name: v1.6.2: Camera Shake Compatibility, Config Updates, and Bugfixes
releases.body:
# Hiker's Mod v1.6.2
**Changes:**
- Added compatibility with the Camera Shake mod by Streetlights Behind the Trees! Performing an Emergency Boost with the Camera Shake mod enabled will now cause the screen to shake.
  - The intensity of the camera shake can be adjusted in the config menu.
- The volume of the sound that plays when you do an Emergency Boost is now slightly quieter by default and can be changed in the config menu.
- The jetpack flame that appears when you do an Emergency Boost is just a teensy bit smaller.

**Bugfixes:**
- The ship's left thruster will no longer create a huge downward flame when you do an Emergency Boost. Thank you to Hotklou for reporting this bug!

**Behind the Scenes:**
- Added a very basic API that can be used by other mods to know when the player is sprinting or Emergency Boosting. This API is a work in progress, so if you want anything to be added to it you can let me know by opening an issue to request a feature.
- Code cleaned up for efficiency and readability.
